title: Chandrayaan-3 public surface photos
scope: Reviewed public release inventory, checked 20 September 2026. Six direct lander-reference assets, two additional 2026 paper figures, and seven supporting surface assets. Annotated versions, crops and stereo composites are grouped rather than counted as independent viewpoints. The registered PRADAN archive was not exhaustively enumerated; this is not a claim to contain every raw mission frame.

exclusions: R_img6–9: far-side orbital images; R_img11: descent imagery; ShivShakti_point: orbital landing-site image. Launch photographs, ground tests and artwork are excluded. Video frames are not counted as independent still photographs.
rights: Original mission photographs remain with their credited owners. Links and checksums only; photographs are not bundled or relicensed as GPL.
